ai.seo_question: What are the three characteristics of the disbelievers mentioned in Surah Qaf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, these three attributes—Manna' (withholding goodness), Mu'tadin (transgressing bounds), and Murib (casting doubt)—are often interpreted as a progressive degeneration of the soul, moving from stinginess to arrogance and finally to intellectual skepticism. This triad is particularly significant in describing the psychological state of those who reject Imam Ali (AS) or the Ahl al-Bayt, viewing their denial not merely as ignorance but as an active, multi-layered resistance to divine truth.
